title: Establish the repo-local JS/TS engineering baseline
description: Create 2-3 shared repo-level quality config files, add `lint`, `format`, `format:check`, and `check:local` commands to both active product packages, and refresh the 2 lockfiles so the local developer loop matches the current `desktop + src-ts` authority path. Keep the first-pass lint/format boundary limited to active package source/config surfaces and do not widen it into repo-wide cleanup.

criteria: 2 package manifests expose `lint`, `format`, `format:check`, and `check:local` or an equivalent authoritative local-baseline command.
2-3 repo-level quality config files exist and target only the active `desktop` and `src-ts` source or config surfaces while excluding build output, generated artifacts, and workflow directories.
The new local baseline keeps desktop validation and src-ts high-signal checks in the local developer loop instead of leaving them CI-only.
0 first-pass autofix scope is spent on docs, `.workflow`, generated artifacts, or historical compatibility surfaces outside the active `desktop` and `src-ts` source/config boundary.
convergence.verification: npm --prefix src-ts run lint && npm --prefix src-ts run format:check && npm --prefix src-ts run check:local && npm --prefix desktop run lint && npm --prefix desktop run format:check && npm --prefix desktop run check:local
convergence.definition_of_done: Both active product packages share one repo-level lint and format baseline and expose a reproducible local validation command that later execution can call directly.

implementation.title: Define shared repo-level quality config
implementation.description: Add the minimal shared lint and format config files plus ignore rules required to cover `desktop` and `src-ts` without sweeping docs, workflow artifacts, generated files, or historical compatibility surfaces into the first baseline pass.

implementation.title: Wire package scripts and dependencies
implementation.description: Add baseline scripts and matching tool dependencies to `desktop/package.json` and `src-ts/package.json`, then refresh the 2 lockfiles so the commands are runnable on a clean checkout.

implementation.title: Promote one authoritative local baseline per package
implementation.description: Compose lint, format check, typecheck, and the current high-signal test or build steps into one clear local developer-loop command for each package.

notes: Keep the local engineering baseline aligned with the authoritative `desktop + src-ts` path.
Treat the first pass as a bounded baseline for active package source/config files, not a repo-wide formatting cleanup.
Do not reopen CI, workflow, or authority hardening already completed in the governance session.
